text: {"lessons":["My account rose for several periods without trades, reminding me that I don't need to act every month; I should make trades only when they fit a clear plan.","I added to Stocks A and D at higher prices, and later sold some shares at gains. I should avoid chasing rising prices and decide in advance why I’m buying or selling rather than reacting to short-term moves.","I want to grow savings toward an apartment, so I should invest steadily, diversify across holdings, and keep some cash available instead of concentrating too much in a few stocks."]}
